shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English, used as a 'listen and find' game scene: the learner hears a sentence and taps the matching subject. Natural everyday photographic detail, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. Every subject named below must be instantly recognizable on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.edit: This is an edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph. Change only what the instruction names.

assets.item: She is sick. / He is sick. / He is angry. / She is afraid.
assets.prompt: A WAITING ROOM with a row of chairs, four adults seated well apart, from left to right: (1) a SICK woman wrapped in a blanket, red nose, holding a tissue to her nose; (2) a SICK man with a thermometer in his mouth, pale and tired, holding his head; (3) an ANGRY man with arms tightly crossed, eyebrows pulled down hard and a deep frown; (4) an AFRAID woman shrinking back with wide eyes, open mouth and both palms raised, staring at a large spider on the wall beside her. Each feeling is unmistakable at phone size. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

assets.item: They play tennis. / They sing. / It is a ball. / It is a guitar.
assets.prompt: A SUNNY PARK with four separate things from left to right: (1) two adults PLAYING TENNIS on a small court, a net between them and a yellow ball in the air; (2) three friends standing together SINGING with their mouths wide open; (3) one big red BALL lying alone on the grass; (4) one acoustic GUITAR leaning alone against an empty park bench. Each in its own quarter of the photo with clear grass between them. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.
